title: Transcriptional regulation of hypoxic cancer cell metabolism and artificial intelligence.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述缺氧肿瘤微环境中O2响应转录因子调控代谢及AI应用，虽涉及TF-DNA调控但缺乏具体互作建模，方法深度不足。
abstract: Gene expression regulation in hypoxic tumor microenvironments is mediated by O(2) responsive transcription factors (O(2)R-TFs), fine-tuning cancer cell metabolic demand for O(2) according to its availability. Here, we discuss key O(2)R-TFs and emerging artificial intelligence (AI)-based applications suitable for the interrogation of O(2)R-TF relationships specifying cancer cell metabolic adaptations to hypoxia.
abstract_zh: 缺氧肿瘤微环境中的基因表达调控由O(2)响应性转录因子（O(2)R-TFs）介导，根据O(2)的可用性精细调节癌细胞对O(2)的代谢需求。在此，我们讨论关键的O(2)R-TFs以及新兴的基于人工智能（AI）的应用，这些应用适用于探究O(2)R-TF关系，以明确癌细胞对缺氧的代谢适应。
